hero3.h1: Stop planning your life around your dentures.
hero3.hero-lead: Four or more implants and one fixed arch that stays in. No adhesive, no soaking, no taking anything out. Dr. Gregory Bennett places and restores full-arch cases himself, here on Wadsworth Boulevard.
hero3.hero-microproof: Fully guided All-on-X · Same-day fixed teeth · IV sedation in-house
hero3.urgent-note-title: A published price, not a phone-call estimate
hero3.urgent-note: a fixed full upper or lower arch is $18,795, which the practice states is more than $10,000 below the national chains advertised on television.
hero3.hero-promise: One consultation tells you where you stand. Free, and no pressure to book on the day.

section5.h2: One consultation tells you where you stand.
section5.text: Dr. Bennett examines you, scans the jaw, and says plainly whether a fixed arch is possible in your case, including when it is not. You leave with a written plan and a real number.
section5.span3: A plan built for your jaw, in writing
section5.span4: The published price, applied to your case
section5.fine-print: An online request is not a confirmed appointment until the office speaks with you. $18,795 refers to a fixed full upper or lower arch; anything more complex is quoted in writing after examination and 3D imaging.
section-navy6.text: An implant-supported denture attaches to two or more implants and can still be removable. A full-arch restoration is fixed on four or more implants and stays in permanently, which is the difference between managing dentures and forgetting about them.
section7.h2: Teeth that behave like teeth again.
section7.benefit-text: The arch is secured to the implants and stays in. Nothing is removed for cleaning, and nothing shifts while you talk.
section7.benefit-text2: Chewing force goes through the implants into the jaw, so the foods dentures rule out come back onto the menu.
section7.benefit-text3: The arch is matched to your face, skin tone and gum line, and finished in the practice's own lab.
section7.benefit-text4: Missing roots let the jawbone recede. Implants fuse with the bone and stop that drift.
section-sand8.h2: What a restored arch can look like.
section-sand8.text: This clinical case is from Arvada Dental Center's official patient gallery. Your own result depends on your scan, your bone volume and your general health, which is exactly what the consultation is for.
section9.h2: Four steps to a fixed arch.
section9.journey-text: Dr. Bennett examines you and scans the jaw to measure what bone is available, then tells you plainly what is possible.
section9.h32: A plan built for your jaw
section9.journey-text2: Implant positions are planned digitally on the scan before surgery, rather than judged in the chair on the day.
section9.journey-text3: Four or more implants are placed using fully guided technique, and a fixed set of teeth is usually fitted the same day.
section9.journey-text4: The implants fuse with the bone over the following weeks, then your permanent arch goes on, finished in the practice's own lab.

section13.faq-toggle: Do I really walk out with teeth the same day?
section13.faq-answer: Usually, yes. The practice places four or more implants and fits a fixed set of teeth on the day of surgery. The final restoration comes later, once the implants have fused with the bone. Whether same-day placement is possible in your case depends on your scan.
section13.faq-toggle2: What if I don't have enough bone?
section13.faq-answer2: It is common, and it does not automatically rule you out. Dr. Bennett is trained in advanced options including zygomatic implants for cases where conventional placement is not possible. The scan tells you which category you are in.
section13.faq-toggle3: How is this different from an implant-supported denture?
section13.faq-answer3: An implant-supported denture attaches to two or more implants and can still be removable. A full-arch restoration is fixed on four or more implants and stays in permanently.
section13.faq-toggle4: Will I be asleep for it?
section13.faq-answer4: You can be. Dr. Bennett is board certified to administer IV sedation and does so himself, which is a large part of why anxious patients get treated here at all. Monthly payment plans are available; note that HMO and Medicaid plans are not accepted.
cta14.h2: One consultation tells you where you stand.
cta14.text: A 3D scan, a plan built for your jaw, and the published price applied to your case. No pressure to book anything on the day.
